description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This part is the Suzuki OEM door glass for Both Sides!
You will also receive the attachment seals and metal frame to attach the glass to the regulators.
With the new Rubber glass seal and metal glass frame installing this is a breeze.
OEM Parts
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Door Glass / LH Side (Drivers Side)
Qty 1 – Door Glass / RH Side (Passengers Side)
Qty 4 – Rubber Glass Seals (2 for each side)
Qty 2 – Glass Mounting Frames (1 for each side)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
